parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of zero-padding for the Y specifier in django.utils.dateformat.DateFormat. However, it introduces a potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of the Y specifier to always return a four-digit year with leading zeros. This may break existing code that relies on the current behavior of returning a two-digit year for years less than 1000.
